description: Which large shareholding and tender offer filings name this Japanese issuer? Large shareholding reports, change reports and amendments (EDINET issuerEdinetCode) and tender offer filings (subjectEdinetCode), newest first, from this service's EDINET index. Filer names are given only for organisations; names that appear to be individuals are withheld. Ordered by time only, with no interpretation of intentions; ratios as filed: edinet_large_holding_reports.

issuer.description: Issuer: EDINET code (e.g. E02144), securities code (4 or 5 characters, e.g. 7203 or 72030) or 13-digit corporate number

since.description: Only filings submitted on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: 90 days ago

name: edinet_holdings_tender_offers

coverage.description: What this service has indexed: the date range, missing days (backfill in progress) and freshness.

filings.description: Ordered by submission time (newest first); not interpreted.

lifecycle.description: withdrawn and no_longer_listed documents carry no content.

provenance.description: Freshness receipts for every upstream source used.

items.description: Freshness receipt for one upstream source.

fetch_status.description: found / empty / stale / unavailable / unsupported (see catalog fetch_status_values).

retrieved_at.description: When this service retrieved the upstream data (null if unknown).

source.description: Publisher and URL of the upstream document or dataset.

upstream_updated_at.description: Update time stated by the upstream, or null when it states none.

terms.description: URL of the terms of service.

title: Large shareholding and tender offer filings about an issuer
